title: Orbit Lab — A little universe
description: An original, self-contained 3D solar-system playground with eight procedurally textured worlds, representative moons and rings, labeled planet selection, close-up tracking, camera orbit and zoom, pause/resume, speed control, reset, two overview angles, orbit/label toggles, keyboard controls, responsive layouts, reduced-motion support, and a readable WebGL fallback.

tests.name: Local Vite production bundle
tests.command: node --input-type=module; import { build } from 'vite'; await build({ root: 'experiments/planetary/sol-xhigh-minimal', configFile: false, logLevel: 'info', build: { write: false, minify: true, rollupOptions: { input: 'experiments/planetary/sol-xhigh-minimal/index.html' } } });

knownLimitations: Browser localhost access was unavailable, so no browser, visual, or interaction checks were performed.
Planet sizes, spacing, axial tilts, orbit times, and moon motion are artistic choices rather than a physics simulation; the interface explicitly labels this.
A lost WebGL context switches to the readable fallback; reloading is required to attempt restoring 3D rendering.
